name: Jelana
overview: Fast, cached playback analytics inside Jellyfin.
description: Standalone Jellyfin analytics with its own playback collection and an hourly, atomically replaced snapshot. The UI never performs live analytics queries.

versions.changelog: Move the 30-day activity chart to its own full-width row and add a responsive Swedish date axis beneath the bars. Combine clients and playback methods in a tabbed Playback card. Make posters and titles in the most-played rankings open their Jellyfin detail pages. Exact graph values remain available on hover, keyboard focus and mobile tap.

Replace crowded library/media layout with separate Library and tabbed Media Profile panels. Add 7/30-day tabs for new items and mobile-first 44px touch targets, single-column cards, readable typography and tap-accessible chart details.

Add activity-chart hover values, tiny posters to movie and series rankings, consolidate detailed Playback Reporting methods into Direct play, Direct stream and Transcodes, and move video, resolution and audio profiles beside library information.
Load dashboard CSS from JavaScript into Jellyfin's main document because Jellyfin discards plugin-page head assets. Adds asset cache-busting and Swedish 24-hour update timestamps.

Embed the complete responsive dashboard styling directly in the Jellyfin plugin page so cards, grids, charts, rankings, and recent posters render correctly regardless of base URL or stylesheet routing.

Use Playback Reporting exactly as the standalone Jelana dashboard does. Adds hourly read-only analytics, the 30-minute session rule, 7/30-day rankings, library statistics, media profiles, activity, atomic snapshots, and no live queries from the UI.
Initial development release: standalone playback collection, hourly atomic cache, authenticated snapshot API, and integrated statistics page.
